headline: NLEX Flooding Closes Libtong Exit; San Simon Motorists Told to Use Alternate Routes
seoTitle: NLEX Flooding Closes Libtong Exit | FMB News
seoDescription: NLEX motorists were advised to reroute around flooded sections near San Simon while Libtong Exit remained temporarily closed on August 31.
deck: Flooding affected lanes near Tulaoc in San Simon and caused heavy traffic along parts of the expressway.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: NLEX Corporation advised motorists approaching San Simon in both directions to use alternate routes around a flooded section. Libtong Exit was temporarily closed to all vehicles due to flooding.
At Tulaoc in San Simon, some lanes remained restricted and traffic was heavy as water accumulated on the roadway.

sections.heading: Context
paragraphs: NLEX patrol officers were deployed to assist motorists. U-turn slots and exit-and-reentry options were identified for drivers trying to avoid the flooded section.

sections.heading: Why this matters
paragraphs: NLEX is a major freight and commuter corridor. Flood-related restrictions can quickly create long delays and affect deliveries, work trips and emergency travel.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Road conditions can change within hours. Check the latest NLEX advisory before entering the affected section and do not attempt to cross lanes declared impassable.
